$comment: Canonical shape of Prosary's domain model, independent of any one platform's language. Field names here are the camelCase form; each platform's own idiom (Swift camelCase, Kotlin camelCase, C# PascalCase) maps 1:1. See ../ARCHITECTURE.md for the prose version and per-file source locations. Keep this file in sync whenever a field is added, removed, renamed, or its default changes on any platform — see README.md in this directory.

isDefault.description: The starred/primary favorite for its devotion. At most one per (kind, customDevotionId) at a time — see persistence.perDevotionDefaultScoping below.

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 code, or the empty-string sentinel meaning "follow the app-level default language setting" (see AppSettings.defaultLanguageCode).

customDevotionId.description: The bundle id (e.g. "angelus") whose devotion.json defines this favorite's step sequence. Populated only when kind == custom, null/nil otherwise. See PrayerEngine.buildCustomDevotionSteps and ARCHITECTURE.md's "Content bundles" section.

variantId.description: Which of the bundle's variants (alternate step-sets, e.g. the Stations' traditional vs. scriptural forms) this favorite prays. Null/nil = the bundle's default (first) variant; only meaningful when kind == custom and the bundle declares variants.

customOptions.description: This favorite's choices for the bundle's options.json options, keyed by option key — "true"/"false" for toggles, a case id for choices. Only overrides: an absent key means the option's declared default. Persisted as one JSON column on every platform (customOptionsJSON Data / customOptionsJson TEXT / CustomOptionsJson TEXT). Only meaningful when kind == custom.

PrayerKind.description: Discriminant for the type of a saved prayer session. Only the Rosary (deeply configurable, options/calendar-driven) and the Jesus Prayer (a repetition counter with no steps) warrant their own cases; every other devotion is "custom".
PrayerKind.note: "custom" is the single case covering every generic, bundle-driven devotion (Angelus, Stations of the Cross, Franciscan Crown, Seven Sorrows, Divine Mercy Chaplet, Trisagion, ...) — adding a new generic devotion needs no new PrayerKind case, only a new .prosaryprayer bundle with a devotion.json. The five retired per-devotion cases' raw values double as the matching bundle ids; iOS/Android remap legacy persisted rows to custom + that id permanently at read time (resolvedKind), while Windows persists the enum as its int (Rosary=0, JesusPrayer=2, Custom=7 — explicit, permanent values) and runs a one-time PRAGMA user_version-guarded SQL migration. Never renumber or reuse a retired Windows ordinal (1, 3-6).

RosaryOptions.description: Configuration specific to the Rosary. Lives inside a Prayer when kind == rosary. Remains the persisted shape (typed columns, bespoke editor) even though the Rosary builds from the rosary bundle's devotion.json — PrayerEngine.rosaryOptionValues maps it onto the bundle's options.json values (no data migration).

specificMysteryGroup.description: Used when mysterySelectionMode == specific or singleMystery.

specificMysteryOrder.description: 1-based index into MysteryCatalog.forGroup(specificMysteryGroup) (always 5 mysteries per group). Used only when mysterySelectionMode == singleMystery.

includeOpeningPrayers.description: The opening Our Father + 3 Hail Marys (for faith, hope, charity) + Glory Be.

includeFatimaPrayer.description: "O my Jesus...", recited after the Glory Be of each decade.

presenterMode.description: Collapses each decade's 10 Hail Marys and its Glory Be onto one combined step (title "Hail Mary & Glory Be", body = both prayers' text) instead of 10 individual Hail Mary steps + a separate Glory Be step. Announcement and Our Father steps are unaffected. The combined step still sets hailMaryIndexInDecade = 10 so the bead-track UI renders the traditional 10-bead decade (see ARCHITECTURE.md).

cases.description: Follow the traditional weekday assignment (with liturgical-season overrides on Sundays).
Always pray a specific, user-chosen set regardless of the day.
Joyful, Sorrowful, and Glorious (no Luminous), prayed in one session.
All 20 mysteries in one session, chronological order: Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, Glorious.

Always pray exactly one specific mystery (one decade), chosen via specificMysteryGroup + specificMysteryOrder. Appended last on every platform: Windows persists this enum as a raw integer ordinal, so new cases must never be inserted mid-list.

EternalRestPlacement.description: Where (if at all) "Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord" is prayed for the faithful departed.

cases.description: After the Glory Be of every decade.
Once, near the end, before the closing prayers.

MarianAntiphonOption.description: Which closing Marian antiphon (if any) follows the Rosary.

cases.description: Pick the antiphon proper to the current liturgical season automatically.
The Church's oldest known Marian prayer; traditionally recited on its own, without a versicle/collect.

JesusPrayerOptions.description: Configuration specific to the Jesus Prayer. Lives inside a Prayer when kind == jesusPrayer.

JesusPrayerTarget.description: How many times the Jesus Prayer is prayed in a session.

cases.description: No target; the user ends the session explicitly.

JesusPrayerProgress.description: Live repetition counter during a Jesus Prayer session. Not persisted. Immutable on Android/Windows (copy/with-based updates); a mutable struct on iOS — a deliberate, known divergence, not a bug.

PrayerReminder.description: One saved daily reminder time. Not a recurrence rule by itself — see reminders.schedulingStrategy in screens.json's sibling ARCHITECTURE.md section for how each platform turns this into an actual repeating notification.

code.description: ISO 639-1, used as the key into the content layer's translation dictionaries.

RosaryStep.description: One prayer "bead" in a fully built session for any devotion — the output of PrayerEngine.buildSteps(for:). See ARCHITECTURE.md#engines.

subtitle.description: Decade context, e.g. "1st Mystery — The Annunciation".

isScripture.description: True only for the mystery-announcement step, whose body is a real quoted Bible verse.

decadeIndex.description: 0-based, counted globally across every mystery group in the session — never resets per group. What the bead track uses to tell decades apart.

imageOverrideKey.description: For steps not tied to a Mystery that still want a specific illustration — see mysteries.json's overrideImages.

CustomDevotionStep.description: One entry in a generic devotion's devotion.json — a step of the flat "steps" type, an opening/closing step of the "rosary" type, or (closing only) a kind-tagged special step. See ARCHITECTURE.md's "Content bundles" section.

title.description: Literal English display string (the app-wide convention for step titles). Mutually exclusive with titleKey.

titleKey.description: Content key for devotions whose step titles are themselves translated content (the Stations' station names).

subtitle.description: Literal display string, e.g. "1st Station", "For the tears of Our Lady".

subtitleKey.description: Like titleKey for the subtitle — for subtitles that are themselves translated content (the Rosary's opening Hail Marys "for Faith/Hope/Charity"). Mutually exclusive with the literal subtitle.

bodyKey.description: Resolved bundle-raw-first (requested language, then the bundle's Latin), then the shared PrayerTranslations chain, then the raw key — see ARCHITECTURE.md.

repeat.description: Unrolls into n steps titled "Title (h of n)" — deliberately without bead fields, matching the hardcoded devotions' closing Hail Marys.

isScripture.description: The body is a quoted Bible passage, so it renders in the scripture typeface (same flag the Rosary's mystery announcements carry). Set on the scriptural Stations' fourteen station steps.

isScriptureByLanguage.description: Per-session-language override of isScripture — for bodies that are quoted scripture in some languages but composed prose in others (the traditional Stations: Liguori meditations in la/en, scripture meditations in ar/he/ru/tl).

if.description: Gates this entry on one of the bundle's options.json options: "key" (toggle on), "!key" (toggle off), or "key=caseId" (choice equals) — evaluated against the bundle defaults overlaid with Prayer.customOptions; the entry is dropped when it fails. The validator checks every expression references a declared option/case.

kind.description: "seasonalMarianAntiphon" (closing only): emitted by the engine's shared, calendar-dependent antiphon builder instead of bundle data (the Franciscan Crown). "marianAntiphon" (closing only): option-selected antiphon (the Rosary) — optionKey names a choice option whose value picks the antiphon, with "seasonal" calendar-resolved and "none" dropping the step.

optionKey.description: For kind == "marianAntiphon": the choice option whose value names the antiphon to build.

CustomDevotionDefinition.description: Parsed devotion.json — the complete structural description of a generic devotion. Field validity per type is enforced at authoring time by Shared/tools/validate-devotion.py; decoders are deliberately lenient (all optionals) so engines can switch on type alone.

type.description: "steps": a flat, fixed list (Angelus, Stations, Via Lucis, Trisagion). "rosary": decade/bead-structured (the Rosary itself, Franciscan Crown, Seven Sorrows, Divine Mercy). "days": multi-day (novenas, the 33-day Montfort consecration) — groundwork only; sessions pray day 1 until per-favorite day progress ships.

days.description: days type only: [{name, nameByLanguage?, period?, steps: [Entry]}] — one entry per day, with optional shared opening/closing prayed every day. Planned (not yet persisted): per-favorite progress {startedOn, lastCompletedDay, lastCompletedOn} as one JSON column, a session-completion hook to advance it, and a day-picker UI.

eastertideSteps.description: steps type only: whole-sequence swap during Eastertide (the Angelus's Regina Caeli substitution).

variants.description: steps type only: named alternate step-sets [{id, name, nameByLanguage?, steps, eastertideSteps?}], mutually exclusive with steps; the first variant is the default. Resolved via Prayer.variantId.

opening.description: rosary type only. Entry 0 MUST be the Sign of the Cross (bead-track invariant).

decades.description: rosary type only: { ordinalNoun ("Joy"/"Sorrow"/"Mystery"/"Decade"), announceMystery, entries: [{imageKey, isScripture? = true}] XOR count + fixedImageKey XOR source: "mysteryGroups" (the Rosary — decade catalog from the engine's mystery-group machinery: selection mode + liturgical calendar, group-labelled ordinals, single-mystery true ordinal, real Mystery values on steps), majorStep {title, bodyKey, imageKey?}, minorStep {title, bodyKey}, minorCount, postMinor?: [Entry] (emitted after each decade's minors with the decade's subtitle/index — the Rosary's Glory Be/Fatima/eternal rest, gated with "if"), presenter?: {combinedTitle, bodyKeys} (when the gating presenterMode option is on, the minors collapse into one combined step with hailMaryIndexInDecade = minorCount) }. Announcement steps pull title/body from the merged mystery tables by imageKey.

hasClosingCross.description: rosary type only; when true the closing cross must be the literal last step (bead-track invariant), and BeadLayout.build receives it.

CustomDevotionOption.description: One user-configurable setting a bundle declares in its options.json (a separate bundle file, staged by both packers like catalog.json) — a toggle or a multi-case choice. Entry-level "if" expressions gate steps on the resulting values; the generic-devotion editor renders one schema-driven row per option. First real use: the Franciscan Crown's optional closing devotions (seventyTwoHailMarys, popeIntentions — both default true so the traditional sequence is unchanged).

key.description: Unique within the bundle; what entry "if" expressions and Prayer.customOptions key on.

name.description: English UI label (the app-wide convention); nameByLanguage overrides it per UI localization.

default.description: A JSON boolean for a toggle, a case id for a choice. Exposed to the engines/editor in canonical string form ("true"/"false" or the case id) — the same encoding Prayer.customOptions stores.

languages.$ref: See LanguageCatalog.all in ARCHITECTURE.md — la (default), en, ar (RTL), he (RTL), ru, tl

persistence.perDevotionDefaultScoping: save()/delete() clear or promote isDefault scoped to (Prayer.kind, Prayer.customDevotionId), never across devotions — two generic devotions must not steal each other's default slot. Legacy rows with retired per-devotion kinds resolve through the same identity (iOS PresetEntry.resolvedKind / Android PresetEntity.resolvedKind / Windows's SQL migration). See ARCHITECTURE.md#persistence.
